candidates.source_title: Clever Spark Plug Oil Removal Hack 🚗💨
candidates.source_description:
Watch this mechanic use a clever trick to clean oil out of a spark plug well! By placing a plastic cup over the hole and blowing compressed air inside, the oil shoots up and is perfectly contained. A bad valve cover gasket floods spark plug wells with motor oil, but a clear plastic cup and compressed air easily blow it out without making any mess.
